name: Boku no Daiji na Ane wa Aitsu no Omocha
original_name: 僕の大事な姉はあいつのオモチャ
source:
I have a precious sister. Ever since my mother died when I was young, she has always been a substitute for my mother. She has always been by my side, in place of my father, who is often away on business trips. She is always by my side, even in hard times - when I feel lonely, when I feel sad. Even when I feel happy.  She is an irreplaceable and precious person. That's why I thought she would always be by my side. Until I heard those words from Mayu's mouth.

"You see, big sister has a boyfriend now♪"

From that day on, the relationship between me and Mayu changed.

Mayu, who was a virgin, was given sexual pleasure by a man, and her innocent body was gradually developed. And all I could do was watch Mayu change. I decided to accept this reality, even though it was hard to do so, because I wanted her to be happy.

But there was a strange rumor about that man.
“It's just for fun, of course she's a bitch.”
"But I feel sorry for Taku-chan, having such a slut as a family member."
"To you, she's just a precious little girl, but to us, she's just a cum toilet."


An ADV where you can only watch as your beloved sister is deceived and played with by a man who only cares for sex.

translation:
我有一个珍贵的姐姐。自从我年幼时母亲去世，她一直代替母亲陪在我身边。父亲经常出差，她也代替父亲陪伴着我。无论是感到孤独、悲伤的艰难时刻，还是开心的时候，她都一直在我身边。她是我无可替代的宝贵家人。所以，我以为她会永远陪着我。直到我听到真由说出那句话。

“你知道吗，姐姐现在有男朋友了♪”

从那天起，我和真由之间的关系发生了改变。

真由还是处女时，男人给了她性快感，她纯洁的身体逐渐被开发。而我只能眼睁睁看着真由发生变化。虽然难以接受，我还是决定面对这个现实，因为我希望她能幸福。

但是，关于那个男人有一个奇怪的传闻。
“当然只是玩玩而已，她肯定是个婊子。”
“拓君有这样的家人，真可怜。”
“对你来说她只是珍贵的小女孩，可对我们来说，她不过是个精液马桶。”

这是一部只能眼睁睁看着心爱的姐姐被只在乎性爱的男人欺骗、玩弄的冒险游戏。
